verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing a SaaS payments or merchant-of-record platform is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of a public source repository or an open-source license for Lemon Squeezy. The 'license keys' feature is for merchants selling their own software and does not concern Lemon Squeezy's own source.
